title: Helsing backer Plural raises $1.1B to fund Europe's next moonshots | TechCrunch
summary: Despite its size, Plural’s fundraise isn’t (only) for a growth fund: two thirds will go to its third early-stage fund, and one third to a new “opportunities” fund making select follow-on investments, TechCrunch learned from Plural partners Khaled Helioui and Carina Namih.
